facts.fact: ACTPOL says the Personal Data Protection Centre created by Law No. 151 of 2020 had no board constituted as of January 2026 and is led by an acting chief executive who is also an adviser to the Minister of Communications.
ACTPOL says the Centre had published no decisions on its website when it checked on 25 September 2026.

facts.fact: Youm7 reports that the Personal Data Protection Centre, led by an acting chief executive, Suzan El-Okbawy, sent 22 members to a Public Prosecution training course on 8-12 November 2026.
The new Personal Data Protection Center oversees personal data in Egypt and launched its online portal in October 2026, according to Enterprise.
